about: Exercise rotation between training blocks (the athlete, Oct 24, 2026). One lift_rotation row per coach/plan.json block that has swaps planned; blocks without a row keep the routine as it is. Each swap names the slot in coach/strength.json (ex), the exercise now there (from) and the one proposed (to), both ids from coach/exercises.json, and why. Status: draft (the coach's plan, not yet put to the athlete) → proposed (shown on the dashboard Lifts tab and in the check-in, set by lifts.py propose within 14 days of the block start, after checking it against coach/lift_history.json) → accepted or kept (the athlete's tap in lift_choice/<block_key>, or their answer in chat) → applied (accepted swaps written into strength.json on the first run on or after the block start). Unanswered at the block start counts as kept: nothing changes in the routine without the athlete's yes. Logged history never moves: it is stored per exercise id, so the swapped-out exercise keeps its record for when it comes back. Principles: swaps only at block starts; at most 2 per block; a swap keeps the slot's movement pattern, dose and time (25 min, busy 15 min); an exercise stays at least one block and 6 logged sessions unless it stalls 3 sessions or hurts; none in Recover or Taper blocks; swapped-out lifts come back in a later block so the return can be compared with the earlier best.
